text: 你独自在河岸徘徊，细雨带走了身上的热量。你发现一个洞穴入口，便钻进去避雨。
你刚走进去一步便停住了。洞中散出的恶臭令人窒息。黑暗里传来沉重的呼吸声。洞里的居民突然走进灰暗的光线中。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 496
text: As you wander alone along the bank of the river, a thin drizzle chills you. You notice a cave opening and duck into it for shelter.
You stop short one pace in. The stench coming out of the cave is overpowering. You sense heavy breathing in the darkness. Suddenly the inhabitants step into the gray light.
